answer: Require every identity to grow like a cedar: each answered epoch adds an unforgeable growth ring to its tenure root, and payout weight rises convexly with ring count, reaching its zenith only after many seasons. A newcomer with one ring earns scraps, so a farmer splitting stake across a hundred fresh clones gets roughly 1/n^1.5 of one old tree's power. Cloned fleets also leave a relic - near-identical timing and wording patterns across addresses - which peers can cite to slash all of them at once.
